# Foot Forward Edinburgh

> Foot Forward Edinburgh (also known as Foot Forward Coaching) is a youth football academy in Edinburgh, Scotland. It runs weekly membership football camps on the Top Astro Pitch at George Watson's College, Colinton Rd, Edinburgh EH10 5EG. Sessions are coached by founder Josh Walker, a former England Youth International with over ten years in professional football and a UEFA coaching licence.

## Key facts
- Location: George Watson's College, Top Astro Pitch, Colinton Rd, Edinburgh EH10 5EG
- Head coach and founder: Josh Walker (former England Youth International, UEFA licensed coach)
- Format: weekly membership subscription, structured age-appropriate group coaching
- Booking: all bookings are made online through TeamFeePay. General sessions: https://app.teamfeepay.com/foot-forward-coaching/store/3579. Academy weekly membership camps: https://app.teamfeepay.com/s/MiJvo2cp7G
- Phone: 07521 484647
- Email: footforwardcoaching@gmail.com
